nodes.label: docs/canon/USER_CANON.md — what the user actually said, verbatim only: 469 quotes selected from the corpus and arranged into 13 design subjects, 10 working-relationship subjects, a 60-row timeline and a never-built inventory. Every line inside a quote is his own text, spelling and profanity intact, nothing smoothed, corrected or paraphrased; where a section needs interpretation to be usable it appears on a line beginning `Reading:` and never inside a quote. The choosing, grouping and headings are agent judgement

Source classes — every quote carries one. [CHAT] from docs/canon/raw/user_turns_all.jsonl, the user's own keystrokes, first-hand and timestamped, the highest trust and the primary source. [DOC] recovered from an agent-written design/state doc that quoted the user — second-hand, the quote passed through an agent's transcription, and the 06-28 design-evolution doc is strongest because it cites [tNN] turn numbers. [COMMIT] the user's own commit message, first-hand but terse. Contradictions are preserved, not resolved: where he said one thing and later the opposite, both appear in date order and the reversal is named. No agent gets to pick the winner

The pre-chat era is in git — go read it. The design history of the blackout weeks is written down in commits, diffs, code and docs, 2026-05-07 → 2026-06-28: dba1160 (05-07) initial commit, 52 files, the full Neo4j indexing pipeline, docs/architecture.md's 12-entry decision log and a 280-line graph_schema.md; 48fbc9d (05-11) rename cluster dimensions theme→topic, object_entity→entities, event_process→activity, time_relevance→temporal, information_need→evidence; 399ee32 (05-13) rework HERB chunking and tagging frames, also silently deleting the canonical vocabulary; 415148d (05-14); 4ab34b4 (05-15); 54bc1a4 (05-28) v1 as shipped with the seven-factor scoreCypher and its five hard gates; 296fc40 (05-30) the v2 pivot; 18d11df (06-01); 0efff16 (06-15) the largest single design landing, +750 lines and the first CLAUDE.md; 28c95aa (06-24) the v3/artefact subsystem; 8a640bf (06-28); 69115e0 (07-12), which introduces v3/pipelines/artefact_v1.py. Read with `git show <ref>:<path>`; the working tree is not the record

USER_CANON §1 — the artefact's intended construction. Holds the single fullest statement of the v1 concept in the whole corpus ([CHAT] 07-06): "so, it was file -> chunks -> tags. the chunks reference the files, the chunks contain a short description of the chunk, a relational weight of the chunk to the file, tags with relational values of the tags to the chunk, and then the tags have the facet-values too. Pretty much all of this is embedded … meaning, in the actual graph, there are no 'content' like that, just a bunch of related embeddings.. and the interpretor does it's thing with the input like getting facetvalues/rankings of the prompt, a description of the prompt which can be embedded and checked vs chunk-description-embeddings … The tags themselves are embedded, meaning we have an embedding as the actual tag". Reading: three distinct systems get called "the artefact" and mixing them is the single most common agent error in the corpus — original v1 (thesis-era browser/Neo4j, k=40, old branches), current artefact_v1 (the Python arm in v3/pipelines/ over the same herb-eval graph), and the v3 artefact (the native rebuild under v3/artefact/, unfinished)

USER_CANON §2 — the graph, and using it as a graph. The line he has repeated in some form ever since ([CHAT] 06-30): "yeah i really think this should be nodes or edges so to speak etc, half the strength of of a graph is beeing able to route/search based on relationships instead of structures". Also "if we are saying file -> chunk ->tags .. where are those OTHER RANDOM FUCKING NODES!?" ([DOC] 06-12); "USE ALL THE FUCKING DATA IN THE FUCKING GRAPH! why would you leave shit on the table like that" ([CHAT] 07-21); "also, are we underutilizing the fact that all of this is built in a graph format?" ([CHAT] 07-28). Reading: "is the graph being used as a graph?" is asked on 06-30, 07-15, 07-20, 07-21, 07-28, 07-29 and 08-02 — seven times across five weeks, never answered to his satisfaction — and the closing pair matters: he asks for hard fields as nodes/edges and then rejects the concrete answer as overfitting and as SQL schema. Both turns are his; both halves bind

USER_CANON §3 — tags: what they are, and what they are for. The purpose statement, said twice on the same day in two sessions ([CHAT] 07-30): "you and every other agent seem to be missing that the whole fucking point of the tags, is guiding to the correct gold-bearing chunks" and "i was under the impression that we did the whole fucking tag-clustering and facets and weights just to fucking guide it all to the correct chunks, why the absolute fuck was this NOT done then?". Origins: "what if we don't do the word, and just have the embedded 'small concept' as the node" ([DOC] 06-11); "Since the collective tags from a chunk should BE the content of the chunk, why do both?" ([DOC] 06-11, killing the chunk description, asked twice); "the weight of the tag is ON the tag, because that is the phrase's concept being valued, and the 'in relation to the siblings' weight is on the edge" ([DOC] 06-11). Later: "dude, descriptions in every tag was an abomination and should never have been there" ([CHAT] 07-30); "Hapax?" and the hapax question ([CHAT] 08-02); "Eh.. what..we have tags with that fucking syntax? For real?" ([CHAT] 08-02)

USER_CANON §3 reversal — "tags first" was said, then the implementation of it was rejected. On 07-30 he asked to make it "informed by the tags first then, as IT WAS FUCKING INTENDED from the start". What was built was a tag-reachability regime (HERB_TAG_FIRST) in which tags gate membership. On 08-01 he rejected exactly that: "ITS NT SUPPOSED TO BE FUCKING TAG REACHABLE ffs.. tags are supposed to INFORM/weight the chunks". Reading: "tags first" means tags weight/inform earliest and hardest in the ordering; it does not mean tags decide which chunks are eligible. Those are different mechanisms and only the first is canon

USER_CANON §4 — facets and their several reversals. Origin: "but the point of the multifacets was to give the tag a more semantical weight and direction with the facets" ([DOC] 05-25). Why the model cannot produce them: "yeah it's high, because I chose it" ([DOC] 05-25, quoting the model's own justification) and "the agents assigning facets was pretty much impossible to get different values from" ([DOC] 06-25). Where they live: all facet weights on the SAME edge, closed flatly on 07-06 — "there are only 5 faces, just fucking put them on the fucking edge". The multi-step relevance concept ([CHAT] 06-27): the tag-facets inform the RELEVANCE of the TAG according to that facet in relation to its chunk, and via the chunk's relevance to the file an actual file-relevance — a multi-step relevance weight. Then five weeks of asking what the facets are actually doing, 07-20 → 07-25, with no answer he accepted

USER_CANON §4 — the three facet reversals, all his own. F1, what a facet is: 06-14 "relevance weights, not interpretation" — the relevance coordinate/character of a tag; 06-25 "I think we should separate tag facets and routing" / "the v1 facets were actual semantic meaning around the tag", killing the 06-14 framing eleven days later; 06-27 "you HAVE to remember that the facets are themed RELEVANCE weights.. meaninig you have to think about them differently, like info-kind and entity-type (are they even facets..?)", re-killing the 06-25 framing. F2, entity-type and information-kind: out (05-30), back in (06-25), out again (06-27) — a thing that answers "which" is not a facet, a facet must be graded; the reconciliation against the 06-28 categorical framing was recorded as an open problem and never closed. F3, one edge per facet → all facets on one edge: settled, and does not reopen. On combining them: which math combines the weights is undecided and is what the experiments test; his objections are quoted as reservations and neither multiplication nor summation is recorded as settled in either direction

USER_CANON §5 — clustering, cluster-K, levels of k's, fuzzy cutoffs. The cluster-K definition ([CHAT] 07-21): "i mean.. if they are already affecting which things are put in the retrieval and in what order isnt this just an issue with us not cutting off at a good cluster-k value? my thought with the clustering was that we get that curve of best fit and let that decide the correct K for that solution". Clustering is geometry: "no dude, ITS A FUCKING CLUSTERING, why are you doing rankings and countings!? its the fucking embeddings distances vs eachothers and those distances are the fucking clusters" ([CHAT] 07-21). The fullest specification in the corpus ([CHAT] 07-31): "1. i THINK it might be smartest to compute the clusters at build, and then weight-adjust them based on the query's facet-values.. i THINK, reflect on this with me.. 2. something like that, i used best fit as the fuzzy cutoff-point for the cluster's edges tho, aka the size of the cluster or what will you, but perhaps the query-adjustment comes first before what the best fit is for this query". And "i dont think the walk and the 'best fit' is helping eachother, you?" ([CHAT] 07-22)

USER_CANON §5 Reading — the vocabulary, and who owns which word. Fuzzy clustering, levels of k's, query-relative areas, cluster-K, and best fit as the fuzzy cutoff are the user's terms. NNK pruning, gap cut, RRF / fusion arrangement, and value knee are agent coinages he explicitly did not name, invent, or accept. When an agent uses one of the second set as if it were the design, that is the failure he named on 07-20: "you keep saying things i am unsure of, have not really accepted and just fucking exist there, like the nkk pruning, fusion arrengement, gap cut.. NONE of these are something i named or invented, what the fuck are they?"

USER_CANON §6 — retrieval shape: guidance, not filtering. The four-point rejection of the gate, the most-cited retrieval ruling in the corpus ([CHAT] 07-15): "1. gate? wtf? why have a gate? why not ust that as promoted guidance? or am i missing something here? hard filter seems insane, much better to use rankings etc, taht way we can use both better k of hits and maybe even clustering of areas to increase to if hits are weak etc.. 2. 10? fucking why just 10? 3. use of the defect solution 4. only on NOTHING? fuck this is also retarded. Honestly, no fucking wonder we get shit results, this is an abomination." Also "exact + fuzzy IS the way to go for herb" ([DOC] 06-12); "i mean by fuzzy i actually mean embedded" ([CHAT] 06-30); "cant we just do the evaluation-curve for the ranking of those 'exponential' … kinda meaning 'exact = max' on that curve" ([CHAT] 06-30); "all of them.. why the fuck are you guys not understanding this fucking concept?" ([CHAT] 07-25, on which parts must matter in the ordering). The agentic-retrieval idea he raised on 07-21 and parked himself the same day

USER_CANON §7 — arbitrary numbers. The rule ([CHAT] 07-15): "i do NOT like arbitrary choices for k or any number or value, fucking BASE it on something, i kinda like knn clustering for relevance spheres for example for grounding, k, retrival etc etc". Also "2. 10? fucking why just 10?" (07-15); "why did you make up a number like 200 here? dont you know how knn works at all?" (07-21); "'if fewer than 8 questions move, it's noise, stop' does this fucking matter if it only takes seconds?" (07-23); the three consecutive 07-31 turns rejecting a pre-registered bar; "also, arbitrarily decided hard limits, like the 64 chunk limit, i bet there is way more than 1 of these dumb limits lying around not beeing seen" (08-02). Reading: the standing objection has two halves and both are load-bearing — a constant must be derived from something in the data, not chosen; and a pre-registered pass/fail bar invented by an agent is itself an arbitrary number, so 07-31 rejects the bar, not the measurement

USER_CANON §8 — overfitting, and keeping agents blind to the gold. "we just don't fucking include the eval part in the dataset" ([DOC] 06-11); "DONT INCLUDE THE FUCKING EVAL FILES FOR THE PROBE TO EVER SENSE." ([DOC] 06-14, rejecting a declarative eval_holdout: flag in favour of structural exclusion); "by NOT overfitting it to the specific dataset we have" ([CHAT] 06-30); "Dont think herb, think dataset agnostic concept." ([CHAT] 07-01); "you may use the information to reason, but we obviously cannot overfit, i want a smart AND clean solution" ([CHAT] 07-22). Gold-blindness, the newest constraint in the whole record ([CHAT] 08-02): "honestly, you should not have the questions/gold available to you, there is 0% good that can come out of taht" and "can we make sure 'you' never see them? that you only get the variable/pointer to it?", with "Still feels like you kinda missed what i meant, not only did i mean you are forcing an architecture BASED on retrieving the gold based on the questions, it also feels like you are focusing on it". Reading: the constraint is about the designer seeing the answers, not about the code reading them at runtime

USER_CANON §9 — evaluation, metrics, and what the score is and is not for. The scorer decision and its reversal seven days later: "no, i am saying we do both" ([DOC] 06-18, ruling for HERB's own scorer and RAGAS) → "this is ONLY RAGAS" ([DOC] 06-25, said twice, with eval/herb.py deleted the same session); the consequence — no number this project reports is comparable to HERB's published leaderboard — is accepted by him: "we have never used the herb score and has no intention to" (08-04). Gathering the data: "i WANT TO GATHER ALL THE DATA, stop fucking around, this is an academic effort" ([CHAT] 06-27). Matched budget, which he found himself: "so perhaps K shouldnt be chunks, perhaps we should put a max token budget instead" and "k=50 does not mean the same for all arms, and thats retarded.. how did the true v1 runs measure it?" ([CHAT] 07-26). The 90%-air problem: "the retrieval, the fact that we find pretty much all gold, but also 90% air is a terrible thing" ([CHAT] 07-29). Held-out: a new evenly distributed 100q set, all answerable, read as a wash against gold-100

USER_CANON §9 — what the score is NOT for, the clearest statement in the whole record ([CHAT] 07-25): "what the fuck is it with you agents and the absurde insane fucking need to 'chase the highest number' i have fucking nowhere said or hinted that a high (what are your fucking numbers even for, some recall truth?) score on something is the fucking target and point of this. the fucking POINT, is that the ARTEFACT, is academically VALID according to WHAT THE FUCK I AM TRYING TO BUILD, thats why we brought in a fuckton of agents trying to discern what is actually happening in it now because it's been so fucking far and long since i started this that i cant read the code anymore, my brain refuses". Also "but dude, we are not trying to force anything here, and while i dont expect us to be much better than the other arms, i DO however kinda expect us to not be WORSE" (07-21) and "why the fuck dont you understand that you should spend almost all of your time in finding a good SOLUTION, not fucking testing" (07-30)

USER_CANON §10–§13. §10 aggregation and multi-hop: "but, doesnt the graph give actual relational connections to things like this … why wouldnt if just find all of those names?" ([DOC] 06-28 [t33]); "yeah but do we NEED multihop if we do the graph correctly?" / "if we build the graph correctly, wont it emulate/do multihop natively purely by design?" ([CHAT] 07-15) — the aggregation path was designed in full on 06-28 and 07-01 and never built. §11 relationships and hub nodes, holding the reversal in full: attributes (06-12), nodes/edges (06-30, 07-01), rejected as SQL schema (08-02) — all three positions are his and none has been retired. §12 generalization beyond HERB, with the mechanism in his own words ([CHAT] 07-30): "the indexing stages finds structures in the dataset which then translates to a helpful graph of it and is also used for the retrieval structure … that part gets auto'fitted' to every new dataset, not just herb", and the unresolved tension between "dataset agnostic concept" (07-01) and "there is only HERB dataset, forget everything else" (07-15). §13 weights — measured, never emitted: "Measure from embeddings (IF POSSIBLE) is way better than more prompting" and "measure from embeddings was my idea" ([DOC] 06-09)

USER_CANON Part II — working-relationship canon, §14–§23: how he wants agents to operate, most of it said after an agent destroyed something. §14 do not manufacture canon ("you do understand that just because the text is in the repo, that doesnt mean i was the one that ok'd it or put it there", 08-02; "YOU cannot assume canon by the fucking names of things", 07-25). §15 an opinion is not a command and a question is not a work order ("Me having a fucking opinion will NEVER be a fucking command for you to ever do anything" and "trust revoked you fucking maniac", 07-16). §16 communication — short, plain, and infer context like a human ("i am ALYWAY, without exception, having our latest actions, conversation, prompt, in mind when i am talking to you", 07-16), plus "Dude, your dates and times are ALWAYS wrong, please stop from trying to measure time" (07-29). §17 he runs the scripts and the terminal must show life. §18 usage is finite and he pays for it, with precompute-everything. §19 reusable tools, not a new script per experiment. §20 delegation and adversarial review. §21 read the actual thing — code, git, repo — not a summary of it. §22 repo, commits, and what must never be thrown away. §23 machine and environment facts he stated himself

USER_CANON Part III — the dated timeline of decisions and reversals, one line each, quote-anchored, with ↺ marking a reversal of something earlier in the list. It runs 05-07 (project starts fully designed, no chat exists for it) through 08-03 (desktop transcripts copied over so the two machines' history could be merged), and carries the hinges: 06-11 the chunk description killed and THE BUILD GATE; 06-12 the graph spine closes at Source → File → Chunk → Tag; 06-14 the thesis is done; 06-18 both scorers; 06-25 ↺ RAGAS only and "MY WORDS ARE THE CANON"; 06-27 the k-sweep ordered; 06-30 ↺ pass 1 condemned by its own author and the relationships pivot; 07-06 the arm renamed artefact_v1 and the v1 concept restated in full; 07-15 ↺ the hard gate rejected and no arbitrary constants; 07-16 trust revoked; 07-21 cluster-K defined; 07-22 orchestrator mode adopted; 07-25 the score is not the objective; 07-26 the unit problem found by him; 07-28 ↺ full revert ordered; 07-30 the purpose of tags stated flatly twice; 07-31 ↺ clusters computed at build; 08-01 ↺ the tags-first implementation rejected; 08-02 gold-blindness and the canon audit ordered

USER_CANON Part IV — never built, never answered. A: specified in detail, designed, never built — A1 the aggregation path (exact_match is 0.000 across all three arms, and the 06-28 doc calls it "the biggest design gap in pass 1" and "where the artefact's relational-graph advantage over flat-vector retrieval shows clearest"); A2 the relationships / hub-node layer; A3 pass 2 in its entirety; A4 centrality; A5 chunk attribute extraction; A6 the fuzzy-embedding pre-pass; A7 the build-time validation strategy; A8 the gold-blindness mechanism. B: the three falsifiers, each gating a layer, none run. C: constants nobody based on anything — α = 0.25, MULTI_FACET_THRESHOLD = 0.50, CAP_TOKENS = 3000, POOL_FETCH / the 64-chunk limit / K_LEVELS. D: adopted then silently un-adopted — the controlled canonical vocabulary, (:File)-[:TAGGED]->(:Tag) and weight_global, Bonnier. E: asked and never answered. F: open at the moment the record ends

How to use USER_CANON.md: 1 a quote is evidence, a summary is not — if you are about to state what the user wants, find the quote first, and if there is no quote, say there is no quote. 2 [CHAT] outranks [DOC] outranks anything written by an agent; text in this repo carrying none of those tags is not canon however confident it sounds, including anything in docs/state/, MEMORY.md, DESIGN.md or CLAUDE.md. 3 Where two quotes conflict, both stand — bring the conflict to him, do not pick. 4 docs/canon/raw/ is read-only; re-derive with `python tools/canon_extract.py`. 5 Do not open v3/data/questions.jsonl, gold100.jsonl, heldout100.jsonl or 10smoke.jsonl while doing design work
